description: Judge one VDD artifact against the coverage invariants: A every parent has a child, B every child names a known parent, C every parent has a dedicated child. Pass the artifact text and, for any phase with a parent, the parent artifact. Returns PASS or FAIL with one reason per failure and the coverage matrix. The procedure for writing the artifact is the skill of the same phase — see skill://vdd-<phase>/SKILL.md.

declaredCounts.description: Counts you declared before generating, keyed goals / pillars / actions / specs / components / tasks. Each phase compares only the keys it consumes; omit it and no count is checked.

phase.description: Phase of the artifact you are submitting

priorArtifacts.description: Phase name → artifact text. The parent artifact supplies the parent ids this phase must serve.

name: vdd_check

backward_sound.description: Children whose serves value names a known parent (invariant B)

dedicated.description: Parents with a child no other parent shares (invariant C)

forward_covered.description: Parents with at least one child (invariant A)

matrix.description: Parent id → child ids that declare it

reasons.description: One line per failed check, naming the id to fix

title: Check one VDD artifact
